## Result

- Skill: delivery-review.
- Review status: approved.
- Package members: registered primary plan — docs/plans/2026-09-09-release-model-source-consolidation.md. Other subjects are governing/contextual evidence, not additional Delivery members.
- Upstream review ID: design-review-r5; proposal-review-r5 renews direction reliance.
- Review ID and round: delivery-review-r2, round2.
- Traceability result: unchanged sufficient REL-SR-01–24, scoped SYS-SR-02/04/06/07/08/09, DES-SR-13/18/19/21 and R7/R8 allocation through M1–M4/TG-01–08/TG-FINAL-01.
- Material findings: none.
- Correction targets: none; no plan amendment or work reinitialization required.
- Recording status: recorded upon successful primary persistence.
- Open blockers: none for this Delivery renewal.
- Immediate next stage: return to route for existing authorized execution; route owns M4/progression.
- Claim limitations: current reliance renewal on the exact unchanged primary plan, not implementation completion, source retirement, final review, Verify, publication or PR readiness.

## Independence and bounded renewal

The independent Delivery reviewer authored none of the proposal, Design, plan, engineering or tests. Subsequent work by this agent consisted of independent milestone Code Reviews and original-reporter finding assessments, not authorship. It now renews Delivery applicability after a factual Design update, preserving delivery-review-r1 with its original judgment/subjects and stale applicability. No Design, plan, work or activity was edited or initialized by this assessment.

The primary plan remains exactly a9604c2e49e78193c40b538023af54b791623ae9ecb0cb56d551a1f07af87985. Fresh inspection of the complete affected Design diff and M4/final allocations confirms three descriptive updates only: Release names the candidate/executor/coordinator helpers, describes the already-allocated one-protected-job workflow, and makes final Verify's coordinated-adoption condition explicit in Release/System. No numbered requirement, decision, displacement-map clause, scenario or Delivery allocation changed. Design r5 approves the exact four-model/scoped-legacy package. Other unchanged mappings and full-plan analysis from r1 remain applicable; its old observed implementation baseline is historical and is not asserted to describe current code.

## Current plan feasibility and proof allocation

M1 immutable preparation/checks precedes M2 provider-bound execution/reporting, followed by M3 actual CLI/CI integration and then M4 exact-source cleanup. The current helpers and protected workflow match the components that the unchanged plan expressly anticipated. TG-01/02 retains actual archive-to-metadata/index-to-packed-install proof; TG-03/04 retains exact approval, negative authority, CAS, uncertain outcome and durable recovery; TG-05/06 retains one protected environment and actual CLI complete-path proof with external substitutes only. The factual Design update does not require a fifth milestone, a different order, a new approval boundary or a different check owner.

M4 still requires exactly the four mapped spec/test-spec documents and two ADRs, only the exact architecture prose dispositions, coherent current readers, retained operational baselines/history, and FU-013 Release disposition without closing its other owners. Its dependency on implemented and independently assessed M1–M3 remains intact. The revised final-Verify condition agrees with M4's existing dependency text and final checkpoint; source editing in M4 does not itself claim successful coordinated adoption. Newly unowned responsibilities return to Design rather than silently adding a seventh deletion.

TG-FINAL-01 still requires applicability of the completed operator path against final source/consumer dependencies after removal; changed build/check/configuration inputs require affected reruns. The plan separately requires a fresh final whole-change Code Review after all milestones/corrections and distinct Verify afterward. No historical citation or source retirement retargets old judgments onto replacement models. Current semantic displacement ownership is the approved Release Design; r1's inspected source clauses remain its historical review basis, not an additional independently maintained current contract.

Existing `release-verify.sh`, actual CLI coordinator, test discovery and selected `ci.sh` commands remain feasible and aligned with the plan. M3 evidence and its milestone review substantiate the observed implementation placement, but this Delivery assessment does not reissue Code Review or turn local fixture/selected-CI results into hosted/public success. Final immutable PR-range checks remain allocated; source cleanup alone does not invent a live-publication requirement or waive touched-reader checks.

## Evidence and limits

Actually performed: read exact Design diff, current primary plan and its affected M4/final sections; compare unchanged primary-plan identity; inspect original Delivery basis, current helpers/workflow and current upstream review records; refresh subjects via primary CLI; record targeted review; scoped record-store validation and git diff --check afterward. No release/build/publication experiment was run by this bounded Delivery renewal. The independent M1–M3 reviews and their evidence remain separate judgments. No operational source, historical record, plan or work initialization is changed here.
independence_basis: Independent nonauthor renewed exact unchanged plan against factual Design r5 and current implementation placement; prior activity was assessment only, with no engineering or routing edits.
